rationale: Frozen objective: minimize ttft_ms for the interactive workload (batch=1, prompt_tokens=256, single RTX 4090, BF16 SDPA Qwen3-4B); clean reference ttft_ms=25.11. The only listed revision is f5a797fab6e3796855819951a220124f9d6305b3152f9de9304b60b3a17d4030 (bundles trial-fc57bca7b9-param-f71a7c8a and trial-recovered-19ccfe875f-param-44a0e934), and the framework will run collectors on exactly this candidate. Observed uncertainty from evaluation.json: the screening decision is 'no_valid_parameter_candidate' with quality_and_coverage_valid=false, and all route evidence is candidate-declared telemetry - 728 fused-rms-norm/fused-rms-norm-gated invocations and 2 'parent-fallback:setup-failure:flash-dispatch-refused' routes on call 2441f10600ba127de5cb753c - with the explicit interpretation that such labels must be corroborated by traces or actual exception evidence. (1) candidate_diagnostics: capture the handled exception and propagated library traceback locations behind the flash-dispatch refusal plus executed calls and scalar returns, establishing whether a real library-side setup refusal occurred; no assumption is made that the 2 fallback sites are a performance regression or that reference invocations (68/145 per bundle) are necessarily fallback - they may implement fallback, verification or composition. (2) nsys (available, runs separately): resolve the attribution questions the declared routes raise - confirm fused RMS-norm kernel entries actually executed during the measured prefill window, locate the two refused-dispatch sites' kernel context, and attribute prefill kernel time against the 25.1 ms TTFT budget; torch already ran (coverage.json shows all 66441 kernels associated), so nsys is selected only for route corroboration and prefill attribution, not re-profiling. (3) binding_cost: a candidate exists and is additive (parent 20b69c25... retained, both bundles added; bundle trial-fc57bca7b9 delegates to the parent on 62 of 64 invocations), and the binding summary (requested legacy, effective direct, reason 'no functional replacements', functional_sites null) is exactly the eligible direct-binding case where zero functional replacements does not imply zero binding overhead for ttft-relevant host dispatch; requesting the clean AB/BA whole-invocation passthrough comparison with full quality checks, which will also run in subsequent candidate resource feedback. Excluded: nccl_tuning, collective_calibration and device_telemetry (single-device, no collectives; device-wide NVML readings cannot yield per-kernel attribution), python_runtime (perturbs execution; redundant with the clean binding_cost AB/BA), execution_timeline (torch trace already associated every CPU submission to its CUDA kernel with no unassociated kernels or ambiguous sequences, and the workload's explicit first-token synchronize already bounds GPU completion, so no CPU-submit attribution gap remains).
